name: background-beams-with-collision
title: Background Beams With Collision
description: A dark gradient section with thin beams dropping on separate loops. Each beam bursts into a small shower of purple sparks when it reaches the bottom, then starts again.
use: A dark hero or section wants subtle vertical motion with small impact bursts at the base.
avoid: Most of the frames show almost no motion, and the beams are so faint they read as dust.
a11y: Continuous looping beams and spark bursts with no reduced-motion check; the effect is decorative and silent to assistive tech. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide, very dark panel with a soft vertical gradient, a white headline and a pink-to-purple second line centred in the middle. Barely visible purple threads fall from the top, and tiny purple sparks gather along the bottom edge.
behaves: Thin beams drop on separate looping timers; when one reaches the floor it bursts into a small shower of purple sparks and then starts again from the top. The headline does not move.
customise: Pass your headline as children; the parent height and gradient come from className. Beam positions, timings, colours and the spark burst are fixed in the file.
weight: light: Seven thin beam divs on loops plus a short spark burst on impact.
demo: Headline 'What's cooler than Beams?' with the gradient line 'Exploding beams.'
issues: The beams are nearly invisible against the dark panel; frames 1 and 6 show almost no change.
The bright gradient headline is demo copy, not part of the effect.
polishWhy: Restrained palette and clean type, but the beams are too faint to notice.
